# Set up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
```

# Reading

```{r}
spindelboek_samples_raw <- read.csv(file = "~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Spindelboek2021/Metadata/Raw_metadata/meta_samples.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

spindelboek_samples2_raw <- read_tsv("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Spindelboek2021/Metadata/Raw_metadata/meta_samples2.tsv")

spindelboek_clinical_raw <- read_xlsx("~/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Spindelboek2021/Metadata/Raw_metadata/meta_clinical.xlsx")

patient_fmts <- data.frame(
  Patient = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H", "I", "J"),
  Case = 1:10,
  FMT1 = c(37, 61, 110, 46, 49, 143, 153, 487, 21,  95),
  FMT2 = c(48, 76,  NA, 54, 60, 176, 160, 493, 28, 111),
  FMT3 = c(58, NA,  NA, 73, 71,  NA, 166, 503, 35,  NA),
  FMT4 = c(77, NA,  NA, NA, NA,  NA, 173, 510, 41,  NA),
  FMT5 = c(89, NA,  NA, NA, NA,  NA, 182, 518, 51,  NA),
  FMT6 = c(100,NA,  NA, NA, NA,  NA,  NA,  NA, NA,  NA))
```

# Samples

```{r}
spindelboek_samples <- spindelboek_samples_raw %>%
  select(Run, Sample_Name = `Sample Name`, 
         sample_type, case)%>%
  left_join(spindelboek_samples2_raw %>%
              select(Run=run_accession,
                     sample_alias, 
                     sample_title),
            by = "Run")%>%
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = `Sample_Name`,
    delim = "-",
    names = c("Sample_prefix", "Sample_suffix"),
    cols_remove = TRUE
  )%>%
  transform(Sample_suffix = as.numeric(Sample_suffix))%>%
 arrange(case, as.numeric(Sample_suffix)) %>%
  left_join(patient_fmts, by = c("case" = "Case")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract the target FMT string from the title (e.g., "FMT1", "FMT2")
    fmt_cycle = str_extract(sample_title, "FMT\\d")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Get the base day for that specific FMT cycle 
    # Use standard if/else instead of if_else to prevent get(NA) evaluation
    fmt_cycle_day = if (is.na(fmt_cycle)) FMT1 else get(fmt_cycle)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate the Time variable
    Time = case_when(
      # Condition 0: donors should have NA
      sample_type == "donor" ~ NA_character_,
      
      # Condition 1: Any "pre" sample gets "<" plus the base day
      str_detect(sample_title, "pre") ~ paste0("<", fmt_cycle_day),
      
      # Condition 2: Any "post" sample adds the extracted day value to the base day
      str_detect(sample_title, "post") ~ {
        # Extract the digits between 'd' and '-post' (e.g., 2 from 'd02', 3 from 'd03')
        day_offset <- as.numeric(str_extract(sample_title, "(?<=d)\\d+(?=-post)"))
        as.character(fmt_cycle_day + day_offset)
      },
      
      # Fallback for unexpected formats
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  select(Run, case, Patient, sample_type, sample_alias, sample_title, fmt_cycle, fmt_cycle_day, Time)

```

# Join

```{r}
spindelboek_meta <- spindelboek_samples %>%
  filter(sample_type == "patient")%>%
  left_join(spindelboek_clinical_raw %>%
              select(-FMT_day),
            by = "Patient")%>%
  bind_rows(
    spindelboek_samples %>%
      filter(sample_type == "donor")
  )%>%
  arrange(case)

names(spindelboek_meta)[1]<- "sample-id"
```

# Export

```{r}
write_tsv(spindelboek_meta, file = "/Users/sophiehuebler/Documents/ODSi/ODSiData/Spindelboek2021/Metadata/spindelboek_meta_qiime.tsv")
```
